teams.heading: Fiji registered a 63-10 home victory against Canada in September 2025
teams.body: In the senior men's international side's last 11 matches, Fiji recorded their largest victory by beating Canada 63-10 at home in the Pacific Nations Cup knockout stage in September 2025. Across this same 11-game span, the team scored 314 points in total. They conceded 351 points during the same period, which represents an average of 31.9 points conceded per match. Offensively, the side averaged 28.5 points scored per game over those 11 fixtures.

teams.heading: Benhard Janse van Rensburg stretchered off as Bristol defeat champions Northampton Saints
teams.body: England centre Benhard Janse van Rensburg was stretchered off following a significant head injury during Saturday’s Premiership victory over Northampton Saints. The midfielder was knocked out after an awkward collision with Henry Pollock just before half-time, requiring an eight-minute stoppage for medical treatment at Ashton Gate. While Bristol secured a 41-26 win, the incident creates a midfield concern for Steve Borthwick. Elsewhere in the same match, Harry Randall impressed at scrum-half while Tommy Freeman struggled in an experimental full-back role.

teams.heading: Peter O’Mahony details his disappointment following Rassie Erasmus’ Munster departure
teams.body: Former Ireland captain Peter O’Mahony has revealed the personal toll taken by Rassie Erasmus’ decision to leave his role as Munster director of rugby at the end of 2017. Reflecting in his book, All In, O’Mahony admitted he felt "hurt" by the departure, noting that he had fully bought into Erasmus’ game plan and believed the coach was providing the necessary direction for the side. While O’Mahony acknowledged the ruthlessness of professional sport, the loss remained a difficult period.

teams.heading: Hector Patterson attracts Bath interest amid potential England allegiance switch
teams.body: Edinburgh scrum-half Hector Patterson is reportedly being monitored by Bath ahead of next season as leading clubs in England and France track the 21-year-old. Patterson, the son of former Scotland scrum-half Derrick Patterson, has represented Scotland through the age-grade ranks up to the U20s. However, because he remains uncapped at senior level, he is also eligible to represent England through a grandparent, leaving his international future open as Edinburgh face a fight to retain him beyond his current contract.

teams.heading: Dragons defeat Scarlets in high-scoring United Rugby Championship derby encounter
teams.body: The Dragons claimed bragging rights over the Scarlets with a 36-26 victory at Rodney Parade on Saturday. Elliot Dee led the way with a brace while Anzelo Tuitavuki, Rodrigo Martinez, Huw Anderson and Robert Hunt also crossed the whitewash in the six-try win. Macs Page scored twice for the visitors alongside tries from Sam O'Connor and Ioan Jones, while Josh Macleod received a yellow card during the second half of the entertaining encounter.

teams.heading: Japan women suffer seven-try defeat against Ireland in Cork
teams.body: The Japan women's side fell to a comprehensive 43-19 defeat against Ireland in their Test match at Virgin Media Park in Cork on Saturday. Sakurako Korai opened the scoring with an early try after just 5 minutes, with Nami Asari and Nijiho Nagata also crossing for the visitors. However, Scott Bemand's side capitalized on a high penalty count and a yellow card to secure seven tries and consecutive wins following their previous encounter in Galway.

teams.heading: André Esterhuizen and Springbok teammates power Sharks past Leinster
teams.body: Skipper André Esterhuizen dotted down as a Springbok-laden Sharks side saw off Leinster with a 26-20 bonus-point triumph in Durban on Saturday. JP Pietersen recalled six Springboks for the round two fixture, with Esterhuizen crossing alongside Edwill van der Merwe in the second half after Manu Tshituka and Lili Bester had earlier tries. The victory keeps the Durbanites unbeaten through two rounds of the United Rugby Championship heading into next Saturday's coastal derby against the Stormers.
